description:
## X Patch 1.12.1-x.1

* Copy media URL: adds direct photo, video and GIF URLs to a post's options menu (on-device verification pending).
* Retains Fix external post links, Hide Find more and Hide Who to follow.
* Supports X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01.
* Media viewer and long-press context menus are not yet supported by this action.
